All 4 tests pass.

**Root cause:** `src/jobs/processOrder.js` acquired a pool connection but released it only on the success path — no try/finally. Every failed order (bad payload, timeout, etc.) permanently ate one connection. `worker.log` shows order-4013 failing with no matching "connection released" line, consistent with steady leakage until the pool hit zero around 2am.

**Fix:** wrapped the `run(conn, order)` call in try/finally so `pool.release(conn)` always runs, matching the pattern already used correctly in `src/handlers/api.js`.

Next: redeploy the worker with this fix — the pool won't self-heal on its own for connections already leaked in the current process.
